rule: identity = registry kind=='type' and represented in the rule table; compartments from the registry; Immune split by the rule-table branch holding a positive token; Endocrine = allpos markers of the Endo-* leaves; definitional (pos/allpos) cross-branch claims exclude; OR-membership notes

Endocrine.reason: hormones are mutually exclusive subtype markers (panel.DECLARED_CONTROLS); held-out ablation would test the neighbourhood of a removed subtype, so Endocrine is gated by spatial coherence and stability

Epithelial_nonendocrine.reason: no acinar- or ductal-specific marker is declared on this panel; mapped to the common lineage Exocrine, which the integration vocabulary already records as PhenoCycler's default sink

Vascular.reason: registry Endothelial compartment; Podoplanin marks lymphatic endothelium and stays declared

T_NK.reason: registry Immune markers whose positive tokens sit in the T-cell / NK branch of the rule table

B_Plasma.reason: registry Immune markers whose positive tokens sit in the B / plasma branch

Myeloid.reason: registry Immune markers whose positive tokens sit in the macrophage / dendritic / neutrophil branch; granulocytes folded in as the Xenium typer does

undeclared_labels.Neural: no registry type marker survives the conflict rule for this label; the label is not declared and no arm may emit it

excluded.B3TUBB: registry Neural but the rule table makes a definitional claim for it under ['Endocrine', 'Epithelial_nonendocrine'] (rows ['Neural', 'Endo-hormone-negative'])
excluded.CD141: registry type marker absent from the rule table; no identity rule declared
excluded.CD21: registry type marker absent from the rule table; no identity rule declared
excluded.CD34: registry Endothelial but the rule table makes a definitional claim for it under ['Stromal'] (rows ['Mes-CD34-fibroblast'])
excluded.CD56: registry type marker with no broad_compartment; rule-table positive rows ['Epi-endocrine', 'Imm-NK-cell']
excluded.CD66: registry Epithelial but the rule table makes a definitional claim for it under ['B_Plasma', 'Myeloid', 'T_NK'] (rows ['Imm-neutrophil'])
excluded.b_Catenin1: registry type marker with no broad_compartment
